summary: Core Scientific filed an 8-K on May 5, 2026, announcing its acquisition of Polaris DS LLC (Target) via merger of its wholly owned subsidiary, Polar Merger Sub, LLC, into the Target. The Target's material assets include ~40 acres adjacent to Core Scientific's Muskogee, Oklahoma data center, an electrical substation, and utility agreements providing up to 440 MW of continuous electricity. No purchase price/share, premium, or deal value is disclosed. The Target will undergo a pre-closing reorganization, transferring its operating business to Parent Sub (Altair LLC), so Core Scientific acquires only the land and utility assets. Post-closing, the Target will lease portions of the premises to Parent Sub at nominal rent through June 2028 for a winddown. Watch for regulatory and closing conditions; no break fee or advisor named.
